See our full shop policy for details. Description The KHDK Electronics LCFR is a limited-edition overdrive/boost pedal crafted in collaboration with Nergal of Behemoth. Combining aggressive high-gain power with smooth, solo-ready tones, this pedal is ideal for both searing leads and precision-driven rhythm playing. Its classic KHDK build ensures reliability, versatility, and a professional-grade sound that will become a staple on any pedalboard. Visually striking, the LCFR features a choice between the original black-and-bronze chassis or the second edition "The Second Coming" with a white-and-bronze finish. Limited to only 333 units worldwide, it is a collector's item designed for players seeking Nergal's signature tonal aggression. With controls for Gain, Volume, Bass, Treble, and a Mid-frequency cut/boost (on the second edition), the LCFR provides complete tonal shaping for a broad spectrum of high-gain textures. KHDK Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal KHDK Electronics LCFR - Nergal (Behemoth) signature Overdrive Published on December 20, 2023 KHDK Electronics overdrive pedal Information KHDK Electronics The LCFR was designed by Nergal of Behemoth to mimic his favorite overdrive tones, the final design was given the thumbs up after Nergal used it right to tape during recording. This one is a monster, whether you're pushing an amp or setting up a great standalone overdrive tone. Nergal helped design the graphics for the pedal, and Behemoth's singer, Bartek, insisted the paper for the box top and signed COA be made of handmade paper. A lot of care was put into this pedal.
